expo.name: Old Time
expo.description: Old Time is a private messenger for chats, updates, calls, and shared moments.

infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Old Time uses your microphone for voice notes and calls.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Old Time uses your camera to share photos, video, and your status.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Old Time uses your photo library to share images in chats.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Old Time uses your contacts to help you find friends who already use the app.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Old Time uses your location to share live location in a chat.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Old Time to access your camera to capture moments for your story.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Old Time to access your microphone to record audio with your videos.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Old Time to access your photos to share them with your friends.

plugins.userTrackingUsageDescription: Old Time may use this device identifier to measure and improve advertising.
